semiconductor_relevance: High — Ecolab provides ultrapure water solutions and systems critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Ecolab Limited, through its Ovivo Ultra-pure Water+ division, specializes in ultrapure water purification and monitoring solutions essential for the semiconductor industry. Their products include high-purity pumps and online monitoring systems that ensure the quality of ultrapure water used in semiconductor fabrication.
capabilities: Real-time monitoring solutions for ultrapure water contaminants
High-purity water treatment pumps designed for semiconductor standards
